Routine check. Vitals within his usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.

Met with Linda, Mohammed's grandson and primary caregiver. Linda reports exhaustion and poor sleep, and is worried about managing evenings alone. Requests respite. Discussed respite options and caregiver support group.
Routine check. Vitals within his usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.

Added apixaban 5 MG Oral Tablet to the active list. Checked interactions; counseled on side effects. Blister pack updated.
Assisted with light housekeeping and meal prep. Mohammed in good spirits.

Mohammed reported a fall at home on Nov 3, 2026 in the kitchen while reaching for a cabinet. His grandson Linda found him on the floor. Denies head strike or loss of consciousness. No injury noted on assessment. Vitals stable. Fall risk reassessed as high. PT referral placed for gait evaluation.

PT evaluation following fall on Nov 3, 2026. Gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use; Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. Recommend front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and grab bars in the bathroom. Will see twice weekly for strength and balance.
Mohammed enjoyed the gardening group and talked about growing tomatoes as a child.
Chronic conditions reviewed and stable. Continue current plan.

Weight 86.0 kg, down from 92.0 kg on Sep 5, 2026 (6%). Mohammed reports poor appetite and skipping breakfast. Eating about 50% of day center lunches. Plan: oral nutrition supplement twice daily, weekly weights, and dental check for chewing problems.
